crossRefs.note: even those men who brought up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before Yahweh.
So they, and all that belonged to them went down alive into Sheol. The earth closed on them, and they perished from…
When he had gone, a lion met him by the way and killed him. His body was thrown on the path, and the donkey stood by…

translations.web: The donkey saw me, and turned away before me these three times. Unless she had turned away from me, surely now I would have killed you, and saved her alive.”
translations.bsb: The donkey saw me and turned away from me these three times. If she had not turned away, then by now I would surely have killed you and let her live.”
translations.kjv: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had slain thee, and saved her alive.
translations.asv: and the ass saw me, and turned aside before me these three times: unless she had turned aside from me, surely now I had even slain thee, and saved her alive.
